body.message:
I’m still looking for a 2BR in Dubai from October 5th to November 8th.
My preferred areas are JBR, Dubai Marina, Barsha Heights (Tecom), JLT, or Business Bay, but the key requirement is that the apartment is within easy walking distance of a Metro station.
Budget is up to AED 9k month, preferably all-inclusive.
If you have any suitable units available, or anything coming up, please let me know. I’m ready to move forward quickly if the right option comes up. Thanks!
